actions_or_findings.title: SLA-004-B1 — CLOSED — due-order starvation
actions_or_findings.trigger: Previously handled ACCEPTED assignment cycles remain past their response deadline.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The query joins the current active assignment and excludes its timeout marker or matching assignment-scoped log before ordering and LIMIT. Missing or malformed assignments cannot enter the batch. The marker and log are written in one service-owned transaction. Saved order-14 evidence reports scanned=0 on both duplicate sweeps.
